tasks.review: Pilot valid:126 numeric rows,30 factor epochs, original checkpoint replay and unchanged full inputs, metrics independently recomputed, protected hashes unchanged. Covariance outperforms Tucker descriptively; no tuning. Proceed with declared cohort.
126 rows and fixed-state checks valid. A01 seed1 Transformer Tucker gain smaller than pilot, covariance remains higher. Preserve variability; proceed unchanged.
A01 seed2 valid,126 rows; positive but small Transformer Tucker gain and larger covariance benefit. All three seeds retained without selection. Proceed A02.
A02 seed0 complete and independently valid. Tucker Transformer BA gain1.91pp, covariance16.24pp; lower participant baseline preserved. Proceed.
A02 seed1 valid; Transformer Tucker+3.23pp while EEGNet Tucker slightly negative. Preserve both effects. No integrity failures; proceed.
A02 seed2 passes126 rows and immutable-input checks. Transformer Tucker effectively flat; covariance larger. All A02 seeds valid. Proceed A03.
A03 seed0 valid. Transformer Tucker -1.25pp retained; covariance +24.06pp. Operational checks pass regardless of negative effect; proceed.
A03 seed1 valid; small Transformer Tucker gain with reduced log loss, EEGNet BA slightly negative. All evidence retained; proceed.
A03 seed2 valid; Tucker helps both backbones, unlike some prior seeds. Completion/full-input/hash checks pass; proceed A04.
A04 seed0 valid. Small Tucker BA gain but Transformer log loss worsens; covariance not universally best BA. Retain metric disagreement and weak participant performance; proceed.
A04 seed1 valid; Transformer Tucker BA and log loss slightly worse while EEGNet improves. Preserve negative effects. Proceed fixed matrix.
A04 seed2 valid; Transformer Tucker negative, EEGNet positive, covariance higher. All A04 seeds preserved; proceed A05.
A05 seed0 valid; Transformer Tucker+4.33pp, covariance+10.77pp. Full-input unchanged and saved metrics verified. Proceed.
A05 seed1 valid, Transformer Tucker slight negative vs prior positive seed; covariance improves both. Preserve seed variability, proceed.
A05 seed2 valid; Transformer Tucker+3.85pp and covariance+14.81pp, log-loss differences preserved. All A05 seeds complete; proceed A06.
A06 seed0 valid; Tucker BA positive but Transformer log loss worse. Metrics and provenance checked; proceed without metric selection.
A06 seed1 valid; Transformer Tucker benefit small and covariance benefit modest, EEGNet stronger. All126 records and preserved-input hashes pass; proceed.
A06 seed2 valid; Transformer Tucker negative while EEGNet positive. Full participant evidence retained; proceed A07.
A07 seed0 valid; Transformer Tucker BA essentially flat despite log-loss reduction, covariance larger. All checks pass; proceed.
A07 seed1 valid; Transformer Tucker nearly flat BA, covariance+15.68pp, high log losses retained. Proceed.
A07 seed2 valid; small Transformer Tucker gain, EEGNet covariance slightly negative. All seven participants complete; proceed A08.
A08 seed0 valid; both completions help, covariance considerably stronger. All126 rows and factor/checkpoint checks pass; proceed.
A08 seed1 valid; Transformer Tucker+8.05pp, covariance+25.03pp. Stronger participant effect retained alongside earlier negatives; proceed.
A08 seed2 valid; strong covariance and moderate Tucker gains on both backbones. All A08 seeds verified; proceed final participant A09.
A09 seed0 valid; Tucker benefits EEGNet more than Transformer, covariance strongest. Full-input and provenance gates pass; proceed.
A09 seed1 valid; Transformer Tucker positive but EEGNet negative. Retain paired contrast and proceed last seed.
Final task valid; Tucker improves both, covariance larger. All27 tasks reviewed,3402 rows independently verified. Proceed to frozen-source cohort report and independent aggregation.
